items.title: CVE-2026-19490: Critical Vulnerability Affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
items.summary: On August 19, 2026, a security advisory was published for CVE-2026-19490, a critical authentication bypass vulnerability affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. The vulnerability carries a CVSS v4.0 base score of 9.3 and can be exploited remotely by an unauthenticated attacker over the network without user interaction or elevated privileges.

items.title: Operation ASTERIX: Anatomy of a Crypto Fraud Pipeline
items.summary: Rapid7 Labs identified an exposed web directory on infrastructure used to support a cryptocurrency fraud operation. Raw phone-number datasets, phishing panels, voice-dialing scripts & more, alongside evidence that the operator relied on AI coding assistants throughout the campaign's development, together provide an unusual view into AI's impact on modern scams.

items.title: Africa’s Cybersecurity Challenge Is Bigger Than Access to Technology

Rapid7 is expanding its partnership with StarLink across Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, and Kenya – turning existing technology and new investments into clearer risk decisions, faster investigations, and more consistent response.

items.title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Lot of summer shells and fit http profiles
items.summary: This wrap-up brings a full-on shell parade. Thirteen shiny new modules landed, starting with a buffet of RCEs. WordPress WP2Shell, Ghost CMS, Joomla JCE, Langflow, OpenCATS, Pterodactyl Panel, SonicWall SMA1000, Ray Dashboard, a Pix-for-WooCommerce, and for those who like their exploits closer to the bare-metal, the Fragnesia Linux kernel LPE (CVE-2026-46300). Metasploit also got the glow-up of the summer with the new http malleable profiles, MCP functionality and linux multi fetch payloads (more details on the official 6.5 release blog post!). Windows on ARM confirm to be the new first-class citizenship thanks to brand-new AArch64 reverse-TCP shells (both inline and staged), so your Snapdragon boxes can join the party too. Last but not least, an important message: Nyan Nyan Nyan Nyan Nyan Nyan.

items.title: CVE-2026-63520: Microsoft SharePoint Remote Code Execution (FIXED)
items.summary: Rapid7 Labs conducted a zero-day research project against Microsoft SharePoint, resulting in the discovery of two new vulnerabilities that, when chained together, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) against a vulnerable SharePoint server. Today, both Rapid7 and Microsoft are disclosing the second vulnerability in this chain, the RCE vulnerability CVE-2026-63520.

items.title: Rapid7 Analysis: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in JetBrains TeamCity (CVE-2026-63077)
items.summary: A technical analysis of CVE-2026-63077. This is an unauthenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability in JetBrains TeamCity due to unsafe deserialization in the agent polling protocol endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-18577: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Exploited in the Wild
items.summary: On August 2, 2026, N-able published a security advisory for CVE-2026-18577, an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting N-central that was discovered being exploited in-the-wild after an incomplete fix for an earlier authentication bypass issue, CVE-2026-18556 was disclosed. CVE-2026-18577 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative control of vulnerable N-central servers in affected deployments.

items.title: Rapid7 Analysis: KindaRails2Shell (CVE-2026-66066)
items.summary: Rapid7 analyzes KindaRails2Shell (CVE-2026-66066), a Ruby on Rails Active Storage vulnerability that can allow attackers to abuse libvips and crafted MAT/HDF5 uploads to read arbitrary files from the server. The analysis explains the direct-upload type confusion, the HDF5 external storage primitive, how Rails signing material can be recovered, and how the chain can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: KindaRails2Shell: CVE-2026-66066, Critical Arbitrary File Read and Possible Remote Code Execution in Ruby on Rails
items.summary: On July 29, 2026, the Ruby on Rails project published a security advisory for CVE-2026-66066, a critical vulnerability affecting Active Storage image processing when used in conjunction with the libvips image processing library. The vulnerability has a CVSSv4 score of 9.5 and is classified as Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default (CWE-1188). An unauthenticated attacker may be able to leverage CVE-2026-66066 and read files accessible to the Rails application process, potentially exposing secrets that could enable remote code execution (RCE) or access to connected systems.

items.title: Critical VMware vCenter Vulnerabilities Allow Authentication Bypass and Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-59309, CVE-2026-59310)
items.summary: On July 29, 2026, Broadcom published security advisory VMSA-2026-0006 addressing multiple vulnerabilities in several VMWare products. Included in the advisory are two critical remotely exploitable vulnerabilities affecting VMware vCenter Server: CVE-2026-59309 and CVE-2026-59310. Both vulnerabilities carry CVSSv3.1 base scores of 9.8 and can be exploited by unauthenticated attackers with network access to a vulnerable vCenter Server.

items.title: CVE-2026-63077: Critical unauthenticated remote code execution in JetBrains TeamCity
items.summary: On July 27, 2026, JetBrains published a security advisory for CVE-2026-63077, a critical unauthenticated vulnerability affecting all versions of TeamCity On-Premises. The issue is classified as deserialization of untrusted data and has a CVSS score of 9.8. An unauthenticated remote attacker with HTTP(S) access to a TeamCity server can exploit the agent polling protocol to bypass authentication checks and execute arbitrary operating system commands with the privileges of the TeamCity server process.

items.title: CVE-2026-16232: Critical Check Point SmartConsole Authentication Bypass Exploited in the Wild
items.summary: On July 22, 2026, Check Point published a security advisory for multiple vulnerabilities affecting Security Management, Multi-Domain Management, and firewall products. The most urgent of these is CVE-2026-16232, an authentication bypass in the SmartConsole login process classified as improper authentication (CWE-287). CVE-2026-16232 has been assigned a critical CVSS score of 9.1. The vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and authenticate to the management server with full administrative privileges, enabling modification of security policies and configurations.
